scope: Noncommercial retrospective diagnostic; not pristine holdout, causal inference or trading approval

source.license: Binance Vision terms, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 unless otherwise designated; noncommercial research only

label: close[i+2]>open[i+2], ties not up
scaler: Per-fit median/IQR trained only on eligible training feature rows; zero IQR replaced by 1; clip [-5,5]; prepend intercept. Scaler frozen during block. No regularization on intercept.
training: Eligible feature rows j>=90 and j+2<=first_forecast_cutoff; last 365 available, minimum60. Reset each fit. Fixed/adaptive same initial fit; adaptive SGD update only after scored prediction matures.
importance: Ablation with full retraining: validation log_loss_without minus log_loss_all24. Positive means removing this feature/family hurt this learning recipe. Not causal, coefficients, SHAP or percentage contributions.
selection: Using ONLY the two inner validations, retain up to 6 individual features whose ablation loss difference is positive in BOTH inner folds; order by observation-weighted delta descending, then alphabetical. If none qualify use intercept-only. Freeze both modes before outer scores. No iterative elimination, no post-hoc threshold changes.
budget: Per pass: 3 blocks x 2 modes x (2 full inner fits + 24x2 individual ablations + 4x2 family ablations + 7 outer fits)=390 fits. Two passes=780 fits. No HPO, pruning or seed search. Not 30 trials; separate experiment.
report: All 24 individual and 4 family internal ablations per mode/block; all external models and controls, no selecting winner using outer. External family ablations diagnostic only, not feature selection. Pooled by observations, not unweighted block mean.
caveats: Data/history already inspected; retrospective exclusion is not a clean prospective holdout
Fixed training recipe is a new declared choice informed by prior research, not a proved optimum
390 fits per pass is the entire prescribed ablation grid, not 390 tuned parameter candidates
Correlated variables can substitute; importance is conditional on recipe, other columns and period
More columns may worsen predictions; low importance in a weak model does not rule out useful information in a better model
Same warmup, scaler, window and learning recipe for baseline3 and all24; do not compare directly with prior replay scores
No order-book spread or executable liquidity measured; activity and illiquidity are candle-derived proxies
No PnL, Sharpe, costs, Laya, evolution, live orders or paid inference
